_isEnabled.title: Enable MathJax
_isEnabled.description: Whether this course may load MathJax at all. Left enabled, the library is loaded only where the course content actually contains maths

_forceLoad.title: Always load MathJax
_forceLoad.description: Loads MathJax even where no maths is found in the course content. Only needed where equations are injected at runtime by another plugin, which the content scan cannot see

_src.title: Source
_src.description: Leave empty to use the MathJax version supplied with this plugin, which works offline. Set this only to load a different major version, and set In-line config to a matching configuration at the same time

_inlineConfig.title: In-line config
_inlineConfig.description: Leave empty to use the configuration supplied with this plugin. Set as window.MathJax before the library loads, so its shape is specific to the MathJax major version named by Source — set the two together or neither

_loadTimeout.title: Load timeout
_loadTimeout.description: How long, in milliseconds, to wait for MathJax to become ready before giving up and continuing the course without typesetting
